verdict.rationale: Ironclad offers contract signing, including Ironclad Signature and BYOSP, so an audit-trail and completion-certificate story is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never mentions a tamper-evident audit trail, signing audit log, or completion certificate for signed documents. Signed webhook events and API retrieval of signed agreements are adjacent features and do not show document-level tamper evidence.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can rely on a tamper-evident audit trail and completion certificate for every signed document
